title: SEED-L03 per-row outstandingLoanBalance column: the running balance is principal-only and derived
_note: Parity vector pinning the DERIVED per-row outstandingLoanBalance column of the SEED-L03 transactions read-back (loan-3-transactions-after-raw.json), three rows: disbursement 100000.00 (balance 100000.00); accrual 6618.53 carrying NO balance cell (the oracle leaves it absent, null, never zero); repayment amount 8884.88 = principal 7884.88 + interest 1000.00, whose outstandingLoanBalance is 92115.12 = 100000.00 - 7884.88 exactly. The balance moved only on the row carrying a principalPortion, and by that portion alone: accrual interest 6618.53 and repayment interest 1000.00 never touch it. The three request rows transcribe amount and principalPortion only; principal_minor is omitted where the capture row's principalPortion is null. No amount here was computed by this promotion: 10000000 / 661853 / 888488 / 788488 are 100000.00 / 6618.53 / 8884.88 / 7884.88 in minor units, and the post-repayment balance 9211512 = 92115.12 is read off the capture row, not recomputed.

provenance.note: request.transactions and expect.transaction_rows transcribe rows 5, 6 and 12 of the committed capture loan-3-transactions-after-raw.json; capture_case_id names the externalId of the observed loan.
